description: My Property Box are pleased to market this lovely, extremely spacious four bedroom and two reception room property close to the Coast Rd, only around a fifteen minute walk to the universities and City Centre. The accommodation is over two floors and consists of; First floor; Kitchen two double bedrooms, a large living room and bathroom. On the second floor there are two further double bedrooms and another large reception / games room / communal study area and shower room. There are shops locally and buses directly into the city centre. Great value viewing is highly recommended. To arrange a viewing call MPB and speak to the Lettings Team.
